name: proto-link-error-skipped
description: A schema file that parses and fails protoc's link-time validation, here a duplicate field number, publishes no declaration and a schema-unparsed note names it; the other files of the target are read as usual. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
